name: Needle 3
purpose: Sub-50 MB-class on-device model for tool calling, structured extraction and text embeddings, run by the Cactus engine (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: small transformer for tool calling (custom, 20 layers, hidden 768)

variants.notes: parameter count estimated from the 0.28 GB repo size, not stated

pc-12gb.notes: 0.28 GB file fits the VRAM budget (9.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-16gb.notes: 0.28 GB file fits the VRAM budget (13.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-24gb.notes: 0.28 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 0.28 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 0.28 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 0.28 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 0.28 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

strengths: tiny: runs in a browser or a phone
weaknesses: not a general model; no benchmark in the card (they are on the vendor website)

tona_fit.reason: A micro tool-call router in a vendor format, not a coding or chat model; no fit with a local coding worker.
